text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo watches the Arima Kinen. The 
race ends in a massive upset, with the 
overwhelming favorite Mejiro McQueen 
taking second place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is determined to enter next 
year's Arima Kinen and blow everyone away 
even more.
